_about: Where to publish your teaching work. Venues that publish teaching innovations, classroom-ready materials, and scholarship of teaching and learning (SoTL) in STEM+. 'access' is one of: diamond (free to publish and free to read), gold (free to read; authors pay an article fee), hybrid (free to publish; open access optional for a fee), subscription (free to publish; readers need a subscription or membership), proceedings (free to read; you present at the conference and pay registration). 'checked' is the month the access and fee details were last confirmed from the journal, DOAJ, or the society; venues without it need a look at the journal's own page before you rely on the fee.

access.diamond: Diamond open access: free to publish, free to read
access.gold: Open access with an article fee
access.hybrid: Free to publish; open access optional for a fee
access.subscription: Free to publish; subscription or membership to read
access.proceedings: Free to read; requires presenting at the conference

venues.name: Teaching & Learning Inquiry
venues.publisher: International Society for the Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (ISSOTL)
venues.scope: SoTL in higher education across disciplines, institutions, and countries. Takes research articles, shorter notes, and essays on SoTL itself.
venues.fees: None

venues.name: Journal of the Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (JoSoTL)
venues.publisher: Indiana University Faculty Academy on Excellence in Teaching
venues.scope: Empirical studies, case studies, and reflective essays on college teaching. Readers come from every discipline, so write for people outside your field.
venues.fees: None listed; confirm on the journal's submission page

venues.name: College Teaching
venues.scope: Short, practical pieces on teaching strategies and course design that work across disciplines, plus some research.
venues.fees: None to publish; optional open-access fee

venues.name: International Journal of STEM Education
venues.scope: Research on teaching and learning across STEM fields and on integrated STEM education.
venues.fees: Article fee; check the journal's fees page for the current amount and waivers

venues.name: Journal of College Science Teaching
venues.scope: College science teaching: classroom innovations with evidence that they work, written for instructors.
venues.fees: None to publish; optional open-access fee

venues.name: CBE—Life Sciences Education
venues.scope: Biology education research and evidence-based teaching. Innovations must come with evidence of effect, presented the way you would present lab research.
venues.fees: Article publication charge; waivers and reductions on request

venues.name: Journal of Microbiology & Biology Education
venues.scope: Research articles plus short, ready-to-adopt lessons and activities (Tips and Tools) for biology courses.
venues.fees: Up to $1,700 (DOAJ)

venues.name: CourseSource
venues.scope: Complete, student-centered lessons for college biology and physics, aligned to society learning goals. You publish the lesson itself.
venues.fees: Free to read; check the journal's author page for any publication fee

venues.name: The American Biology Teacher
venues.scope: Classroom activities, labs, and teaching ideas for high school and introductory college biology.
venues.fees: None to publish

venues.name: Advances in Physiology Education
venues.scope: Physiology and life-science teaching: research, innovative activities (Illuminations, How We Teach), and sourcebook pieces.
venues.fees: Check the journal's author page for page charges and the open-access option

venues.name: Biochemistry and Molecular Biology Education
venues.scope: Teaching biochemistry and molecular biology: lab exercises, classroom innovations, and education research.
venues.fees: None to publish; optional open-access fee

venues.name: Anatomical Sciences Education
venues.publisher: American Association for Anatomy, with Wiley
venues.scope: Teaching anatomy, histology, embryology, and neuroscience in health professions and undergraduate programs.
venues.fees: None to publish; optional open-access fee

venues.name: Journal of Chemical Education
venues.scope: Laboratory experiments, demonstrations, activities, and chemistry education research. The Activity and Laboratory Experiment formats suit first papers.
venues.fees: None to publish; optional open-access fee

venues.name: Journal of Geoscience Education
venues.scope: Geoscience education research and evidence-based teaching practice, including curriculum and instruction papers.
venues.fees: None to publish; optional open-access fee

venues.name: In the Trenches
venues.scope: Short magazine articles on geoscience teaching ideas and experiences. A friendly first piece of writing about your teaching.
venues.fees: None to publish

venues.name: Physical Review Physics Education Research
venues.scope: Physics and astronomy education research at every level, from instructional strategies to learning theory.
venues.fees: Up to $2,205 (DOAJ); fee waivers available on request

venues.name: The Physics Teacher
venues.scope: Demonstrations, labs, and teaching ideas for introductory physics, in short, readable articles.
venues.fees: None to publish

venues.name: American Journal of Physics
venues.scope: Physics as taught at the college level: new ways to explain topics, apparatus and labs, and some physics education research.
venues.fees: None to publish; optional open-access fee

venues.name: Physics Education Research Conference (PERC) Proceedings
venues.publisher: AAPT and the APS Physics Education Research Topical Group
venues.scope: Short papers tied to posters at the summer PER Conference. Preliminary results and work in progress are welcome.
venues.fees: None beyond conference registration; papers are CC BY

venues.name: PRIMUS
venues.scope: Undergraduate mathematics teaching: course designs, classroom activities, and reflective accounts of what happened.
venues.fees: None to publish; optional open-access fee

venues.name: Journal of Statistics and Data Science Education
venues.scope: Teaching statistics and data science at all levels: research, datasets and stories for class, and teaching notes.
venues.fees: None to submit or publish

venues.name: Mathematics Teacher: Learning and Teaching PK-12
venues.publisher: National Council of Teachers of Mathematics
venues.scope: Classroom practice in PK-12 mathematics, written by and for teachers.
venues.fees: None to publish

venues.name: Journal of Engineering Education
venues.publisher: American Society for Engineering Education, with Wiley
venues.scope: Rigorous engineering education research grounded in theory. Not the place for a first classroom report; start with ASEE proceedings.
venues.fees: None to publish; optional open-access fee

venues.name: ASEE Annual Conference proceedings (ASEE PEER)
venues.scope: Full papers on any part of engineering education, reviewed by the ASEE division you submit to. Work-in-progress papers are a common first step.
venues.fees: None beyond conference registration; free to read

venues.name: ACM SIGCSE Technical Symposium
venues.publisher: ACM Special Interest Group on Computer Science Education
venues.scope: Computing education: experience reports, research papers, and curricular papers. Experience reports are a good fit for a first classroom innovation.
venues.fees: None beyond conference registration; check ACM's current open-access terms

venues.name: MedEdPORTAL
venues.scope: Complete, ready-to-use teaching materials for the health professions: curricula, cases, simulations, and assessments, with evidence from their use.
venues.fees: None

venues.name: The Clinical Teacher
venues.publisher: Association for the Study of Medical Education, with Wiley
venues.scope: Short, practical papers for clinicians who teach, including brief reports of educational innovations.
venues.fees: Check the journal's current open-access terms

venues.name: NACTA Journal
venues.publisher: North American Colleges and Teachers of Agriculture
venues.scope: Teaching and learning in college agriculture, natural resources, and related fields.
venues.fees: Check the journal's author page

venues.name: Natural Sciences Education
venues.publisher: American Society of Agronomy, with Wiley
venues.scope: Teaching in agronomy, crop, soil, and environmental sciences, from K-12 outreach to graduate courses.
venues.fees: Check the journal's author page

venues.name: Science Scope, The Science Teacher, and Science and Children
venues.scope: Classroom-tested lessons and ideas for elementary (Science and Children), middle (Science Scope), and high school (The Science Teacher) science.
venues.fees: None to publish
